method: ctypes C extension (libdihiti.so): fused grad_fast + fused post_min (cumtrapz+detilt+interior-min in one pass, no intermediate numpy allocations). FFT/Hilbert step left in scipy.signal.hilbert (already compiled, not the target).
grid_convention: x = np.linspace(-L, L, N), SAME array object used for baseline and candidate in every comparison -- endpoint duplication (K19/C22) cannot enter as a period-error artifact because this candidate reimplements the IDENTICAL baseline arithmetic, verified pointwise below, not a periodicity trick.

amdahl_diagnostic.description: Decomposition of baseline wall-clock into gradient/FFT/cumtrapz/detilt+min stages, to explain why end-to-end speedup plateaus below the compiled O(N)-legs-only speedup. amdahl_ceiling_speedup = speedup attainable if the O(N) legs were made INFINITELY fast (cost->0), i.e. numpy_total/fft_time -- the hard ceiling for any strategy that leaves the FFT in scipy.

headline.ON_legs_speedup_range: 3.34x - 3.65x across N in {4096,16384,65536,60000} -- CONFIRMS the constants-not-information-deficit hypothesis for the non-FFT part of the pipeline
headline.amdahl_ceiling_at_N2pow14: 1.91x -- PROVES that no amount of further C optimization on the O(N) legs alone can reach 3x at this N, because the FFT already consumes 52% of baseline wall-clock and is out of scope per task brief
headline.amdahl_ceiling_max_observed: 2.37x at N=4096 (smallest N tested, FFT is only 42% of baseline there) -- still below 3x
headline.correctness: 100.00% verdict match (327/327), including 147/147 near-threshold cases (|min eps''| < 1e-2), max abs diff 4.19e-5
headline.verdict: V1 NOT achieved via this route. Clean, quantified negative: the O(N)-legs-only compiled strategy is Amdahl-capped below 3x for every N tested, and the cap itself is below 3x even in the theoretical zero-cost limit for N>=16384. Reaching 3x end-to-end would require also beating scipy.signal.hilbert, which cycle1 already tried (hand-rolled rfft/irfft, results/cycle1_c15_redteam/bench.md) and found gives ~1.0x (no win) once the full analytic-signal reconstruction cost is included.
